text.autoconfig.dragthings.title: Drag Things Settings
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.lerpSp:
How quickly the item moves toward your cursor.
Lower = smoother but slower. (5–50)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.dragFo: Spring force pulling the item toward target. (1–20)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.fricti: Air resistance. Higher = less overshoot and jitter. (70–99)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.throwM: How hard the item is thrown when released. (1–20)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.dragDi: How far in front of you the item floats while dragging. (1–10 blocks)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.pickup: How far away you can grab an item. (1–10 blocks)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.bobbin: Subtle up-down bobbing while dragging. 0 = off. (0–10)
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.emissi: Dragged and hovered items glow at full brightness.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.showTo: Show item name and enchantments when looking at an item.
text.autoconfig.dragthings.option.raiseA: Raise your arm while dragging an item.
